native.tip: people は複数扱い。is ではなく are を使います。
native.caption: “Many people is in the park.”と言っていませんか？😅 日本語では人数に関係なく同じ形ですが、英語の people は複数扱い。動詞は are になります。 “Many people are in the park.” が自然な言い方です。Amaの声をまねして練習しよう！Lexkiteアプリでもっと練習できます。
native.comment: 答え：“are”。people は複数扱い。無料クイズで練習：{link}

en.tip: People is plural. Use are, not is.
en.caption: Do you say “Many people is in the park.”? 😅 Japanese does not change form, but English people is plural, so the verb is are. The natural way is “Many people are in the park.”. Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
